crossRefs.note: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as Yahweh my God commanded me, that you should do so in the…
Only fear Yahweh, and serve him in truth with all your heart; for consider what great things he has done for you.
Further, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he pondered, sought out, and set in…
Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.
They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.
I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,
He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.

translations.web: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.
translations.bsb: I will guide you in the way of wisdom; I will lead you on straight paths.
translations.kjv: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.
translations.asv: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in paths of uprightness.
